guideline: Best-Worst Scaling (BWS) where raters select best/worst recipes based on grammaticality, correctness, and preservation criteria
- Ratings obtained via Best-Worst Scaling (BWS), where raters select best/worst recipes based on predefined criteria.
Raters select the best and worst recipes for each instance based on three questions: grammaticality, correctness, and preservation.

We randomly select one instance for each dish pair, and ask raters to choose the best and worst generated recipes on grammaticality (whether the text is grammatically correct and fluent), correctness (whether the text is a correct recipe of the target dish), and preservation (whether the text preserves the base recipe's cooking and writing style).

overall_notes: The extraction was reasonably accurate. The main improvements were normalization of dataset names and consolidation of duplicate/redundant entries.
